journal.rimeheart.title: Warden's Journal
journal.rimeheart.claim.not_ready: That quest is not complete yet.
journal.rimeheart.story:
The Last Warden

Long ago the northern kingdoms kept a pact with winter. Their Wardens tended the Glacial Altars, and the cold stayed in the far north where it belonged.

The kingdoms forgot. The altars froze over, the Wardens died out one by one, and deep beneath the ice the heart of winter itself, the Frost Sovereign, stopped sleeping.

Now the Long Winter is waking. Frost Wraiths drift over the snow at night, the ghosts of those who froze in the old kingdoms. Crystal Shardlings nest in the rime. Stone turns to rimestone, and iron in the cold earth turns to Frostiron.

I am the last Warden, and this journal is all I can leave you.

Mine the cold iron. Learn how the chill works, because it will be your best weapon. Find a Frozen Sanctum, one of the buried temples of my order, and search it well: our greatest treasure was never kept in plain sight.

When you hold a Glacial Heart, forge a Winter Horn and sound it at a Glacial Altar. The Sovereign will answer. Shatter it, and the thaw will come.

The Quests tab will guide you, step by step. Every quest holds a reward, so return here often.
guide.rimeheart.0.title: Quick Start
guide.rimeheart.0.text:
§1§lQuick Start§r

1. Travel to a §lsnowy biome§r.
2. Mine §3Frostiron Ore§r and §3Rime Crystal Ore§r with an iron pickaxe.
3. Smelt Frostiron. Craft tools and armour.
4. Cook a §6Hearthfire Stew§r for the cold.
5. Hunt §3Frost Wraiths§r at night.
6. Find the §lFrozen Sanctum§r and its secret.
7. Sound the §lWinter Horn§r at the Glacial Altar.

Open the Quests tab and claim rewards as you go.
guide.rimeheart.1.title: Chill and Freezing
guide.rimeheart.1.text:
§1§lChill§r is the heart of Rimeheart.

Frost weapons add chill to what they hit. It is the same freezing meter that powder snow fills: chilled creatures slow down, and once §lfully frozen§r they shiver, take freeze damage and move sluggishly.

Frostbite Blade and Winterfang deal §lShatter§r damage: +30% / +40% against fully frozen targets.

Chill wears off after a few seconds. Winter creatures are immune.

§1Protection:§r wearing any Frostiron or Wraithweave piece makes you immune, just like leather. Hearthfire Stew thaws you instantly.
guide.rimeheart.2.title: Frostiron and Rime
guide.rimeheart.2.text:
§1§lFrostiron§r generates only under snowy biomes, from deep underground up into the mountains. It needs an §liron pickaxe§r. Frostiron gear sits between iron and diamond.

§1§lRime Crystal Ore§r gives Rime Shards. Four shards make a Block of Rime Crystal.

§1§lRimestone§r forms large veins in cold stone. Craft it into bricks for building.

Rime Crystal Clusters grow in ruins. Break them carefully: some are Shardling nests. Silk Touch keeps the nest asleep.
guide.rimeheart.3.title: Tools and Weapons
guide.rimeheart.3.text:
§1Frostiron Sword, Pickaxe, Axe, Shovel§r: reliable mid-game tools.

§1§lFrostbite Blade§r: hits chill. Use for §lCold Snap§r, which chills everything within 4.5 blocks.

§1§lGlacier Maul§r: slow, heavy. Use on the ground for §lPermafrost Slam§r: a ring of ice spikes that launches and freezes enemies.

§1§lRimebow§r: fires icicles without arrows. Full draws hit harder.

§1§lBlizzard Staff§r: hold to breathe a cone of blizzard for five seconds.

§1§lFrost Charge§r: throw it to freeze mobs and turn water into temporary ice.
guide.rimeheart.4.title: Armour
guide.rimeheart.4.text:
§1§lFrostiron Armour§r
Any piece: immune to freezing.
Full set, §lGlacial Stride§r: water freezes beneath your feet, and melee attackers are chilled.

§1§lWraithweave§r
Lighter, better enchantability.
Full set, §lSpectral Step§r: speed on snow and ice.
Full set, §lFade§r: below 30% health you vanish (Invisibility and Speed II for 5 seconds) and nearby monsters lose track of you. 90 second cooldown.
guide.rimeheart.5.title: Creatures
guide.rimeheart.5.text:
§1§lFrost Wraith§r
Hooded spirits that drift over snowy biomes at night. They circle and cast volleys of ice shards. They fade in direct sunlight. Drop Wraith Essence and, rarely, a Glacial Heart.

§1§lShardling§r
Small crystal crawlers that nest in rime clusters and cold caves. Their bite chills. Drop Rime Shards.

Both are immune to chill.
guide.rimeheart.6.title: The Frozen Sanctum
guide.rimeheart.6.text:
Buried temples of the Wardens, found under snowy plains, taiga and slopes. Look for a ring of broken rimestone pillars on the surface and a stairwell leading down.

The hall below holds a §lGlacial Altar§r, supply chests and old guardians.

§1§lA secret:§r the Wardens sealed their vault behind a wall that only looks solid. Look for cracked bricks, and a stretch of wall that crumbles at a touch.
guide.rimeheart.7.title: The Frost Sovereign
guide.rimeheart.7.text:
Craft a §lWinter Horn§r from a Glacial Heart and sound it at a Glacial Altar.

§1Attacks:§r
- §lIcicle Barrage§r: homing shards
- §lGlacial Eruption§r: rings of frost mark where spikes will burst. Step out!
- §lFrost Breath§r: a slow-turning cone of blizzard
- §lStomp§r when you get close

At half health it summons Frost Wraiths, erupts three times at once and attacks twice as often.

§1Rewards:§r Sovereign's Core, a Glacial Heart, Frostiron and Rime Shards.
guide.rimeheart.8.title: Beyond the Winter
guide.rimeheart.8.text:
Place the §lSovereign's Core§r above a Frostbite Blade to forge §1§lWinterfang§r: a blade on par with netherite, whose hits chill deeply and whose §lAbsolute Zero§r freezes every enemy within 8 blocks.

The Sovereign can be summoned again with another Glacial Heart.

The winter is over... until next time.
